caption: The video captures a backlit silhouette of a long-haired dancer moving expressively in a hazy, violet-lit space. Two horizontal neon bars rest low on the left, where a cooler blue glow pools, and two more sit on the right. These bars remain fixed as thick smoke drifts behind the figure. The arms are held bent with hands close to the torso, hair falling to one side. They then unfold outward into a wide, near-horizontal extension that the body holds while swaying and tilting. One hand draws back toward the chest before an arm lifts and arcs overhead, sweeping across the top of the frame. That raised arm descends until both are again extended horizontally, hands open, as the silhouette continues its sway.
